newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET MONDAY MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET MONDAY MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker on the U.S. dollar but was quoted firmer on sterling, the mark and the rand after a fairly dull local interbank session on Monday.

"There was a bit of interbank trade but the market was relatively quiet today," a dealer said, adding the dollar eased against the key U.S. dollar mainly on the back of some fairly heavy buying by one bank to cover its position.
The local unit finished at 11.3060/3160 on the U.S. dollar, slightly easier from Friday's 11.3025/3125.

It however recovered from it's morning low of 18.3025/3245 against sterling to close at 18.2585/2860, tracking a stronger U.S. dollar overseas. This compared with 18.2739/3014 on Friday. Against the mark it was also quoted firmer at 6730/6795 from 6.6811/6900 and was at 2.5320/5360 against South Africa's rand from 2.5325/5364.
